name: lb-names-full-rankings
note: Long leaderboard names scroll in their column instead of overflowing (issue #292; tests issue #455). A name wider than its column scrolls (marquee) on one line while a name that fits stays still; Narrator reads the whole name once in the row's single Button name (the raw MarqueeText adds nothing); every row is one 40+ epx stop in visual order, Up/Down between rows.
after_ready: assertread:id=fst.rankings.row.fixture-player-2|Rank #2, Fixture Player With An Extraordinarily Long Display Name That Never Fits. Total Score 88,000,000, 38 / 50 songs, button
assertread:id=fst.rankings.row.fixture-player-1|Rank #1, Fixture Player 1. Total Score 89,000,000, 39 / 50 songs, button

name: lb-names-full-rankings-text
note: Issue #455 text scaling (leaderboard-row R3, Windows large text = 150%, LargeText.Scale): at 150-225% text the long name wraps onto several still lines inside its column instead of scrolling (it never overflows into the songs label, score or chevron); a short name stays one still line; the row grows (R2), stays a 40+ epx stop read in full once, in rank order.
after_ready: assertread:id=fst.rankings.row.fixture-player-2|Rank #2, Fixture Player With An Extraordinarily Long Display Name That Never Fits. Total Score 88,000,000, 38 / 50 songs, button

name: lb-names-full-rankings-text-reduced
note: Issue #455 large text with Reduce Motion (the defect it found): before, a long name at 225% text with motion off was cut to an ellipsis (full name only in the tooltip); now it wraps onto several still lines like the other platforms (leaderboard-row R3).
after_ready: assertread:id=fst.rankings.row.fixture-player-2|Rank #2, Fixture Player With An Extraordinarily Long Display Name That Never Fits. Total Score 88,000,000, 38 / 50 songs, button

name: lb-names-full-rankings-reduced
note: Issue #455 reduced motion: with the app's Reduce Motion on the long name stops scrolling and ends in an ellipsis; the row still reads the whole name once (the full-name tooltip adds no help text).
after_ready: assertread:id=fst.rankings.row.fixture-player-2|Rank #2, Fixture Player With An Extraordinarily Long Display Name That Never Fits. Total Score 88,000,000, 38 / 50 songs, button
